paragraphs.text: Astartes is a creature subtype introduced for the crossover Warhammer 40,000 . It is used to represent a race of genetically modified Humans .
Astartes is a Warhammer 40K crossover type.

The Space Marines , also known as the Adeptus Astartes ("Those who conquer the stars"), are foremost amongst the defenders of Humanity , the greatest of the Emperor of Mankind's warriors. They are superhuman warrior-monks who wear mechanized suits of armor and are genetically and surgically modified to enhance their combat abilities. Many Astartes have betrayed the Imperium of Man , however, and pledged themselves to ruinous powers .
